notes: Technical implementation of RND-329 media page meets all functional requirements (AC-1 through AC-6). All 6 tests pass. Architecture boundaries respected. However, test_http_contract.py modification by implementation agent violates the file ownership rule specified in AC-7. This appears to be an implementation error where the developer included contract test updates in their working tree instead of keeping them separate. QA agent did not modify any files as required. Recommendation: implementation agent should create a separate PR or remove test_http_contract.py changes before QA re-verification.
